goal: Recognizable fish with an organic lofted body and thin fins
geometry_plan: assume 1 px ~ 0.4 mm so the body is 180 mm long
loft elliptical sections on Plane.YZ.offset(x) along X; half-heights from the silhouette, half-widths estimated at about 45% of half-height
tail and dorsal fin: polygons on Plane.XZ extruded symmetrically 2 mm thick
pectoral fin and eye from the image as separate features
colour each part with the colour sampled from the image and return Compound(children=[...]) so the STEP keeps the colours
